name: Reactor Bootstrap
description: Starts each run with 2 additional reactor repair points restored per level.

name: Recovery Permit
description: Starts each run with 2 extra non-core system repair points restored per level.

name: Scrap Magnet
description: Adds starting scrap and increases scavenged scrap yields by 20% per level.

name: Expanded Hold
description: Increases scrap storage by 120 per level so richer repair runs waste less salvage.

name: Contract Broker
description: Increases successful escape credit payouts by 25% per level.

name: Field Engineering
description: Reduces manual repair costs by 1 scrap per level. Repairs still require player choice.

name: Hull Reinforcement
description: Increases max ship integrity by 200 per level.

name: High-Value Contacts
description: Finds richer contracts with stronger nanite response. Optional risk-reward scaling.
